platforms: IAI Heron Mk II (Indian Air Force, Indian Army -- Tawang sector)
source: Added for the Heron Mk II gap identified in docs/audit/10_red_team_readiness_review.md Sec 2.8: the IAF/Army fly the 915 iS, not the 914, and this repository previously had no config for it. See the per-field "provenance" map -- only displacement, power ratings, induction/cooling and TBO are public; bore/stroke/CR, turbo details, gearbox ratio, mass and nominal fuel/air figures are scaled from the shared 912iS/914 architecture (same bore-class, same stroke as the 912 iS/914 family) pending a Rotax 915 iS operator's manual.

platforms.ref: Janes -- 'Indian Air Force inducts Heron Mk II'; Indian Army Heron Mk II induction reporting (2022), both citing the Rotax 915 iS as the Mk II's engine vs. the base Heron's 914 (see docs/audit/10 Sec 2.8)

layout.displacement_cc.ref: 1,352 cc -- BRP-Rotax public spec sheet (matches the 912 iS's displacement, turbocharged)

layout.bore_mm.ref: not independently confirmed for the 915 iS specifically; consistent with the 912iS/914 bore class

layout.stroke_mm.ref: assumed identical to 912iS/914 (61.0mm); not independently confirmed

layout.compression_ratio.ref: assumed similar to 914; not independently confirmed

turbo.critical_altitude_ft.ref: no source -- Heron Mk II's >10,000m (~32,800 ft) service ceiling is an airframe figure, not this field (turbo boost-hold altitude)

turbo.intercooled.ref: 915 iS is reported as a more heavily reworked turbo system than the 914's; intercooling assumed but not confirmed

rated_power_kw.ref: 141 hp = 105.1 kW takeoff -- BRP-Rotax public spec sheet

max_continuous_power_kw.ref: 135 hp = 100.7 kW continuous -- BRP-Rotax public spec sheet

rated_rpm.ref: assumed identical to 912iS/914 family (5,800 rpm); not independently confirmed

gearbox_ratio.ref: assumed identical to 912iS/914 (2.4286); the 915 iS may use a different reduction ratio -- not confirmed

dry_mass_kg.ref: no source; estimated above the 914's 76kg for the larger turbo/intercooler

tbo_hours.ref: 1,200 h -- BRP-Rotax public spec sheet (shorter than the 914's 2,000 h)

max_continuous_rpm.ref: assumed identical to 912iS/914 family; not independently confirmed

idle_rpm.ref: assumed identical to 912iS/914 family; not independently confirmed

operating_limits.cht_max_c.ref: legacy literal from backend/ml/detection_pipeline.py (135/850) and the plant hard-failure threshold (0.8 bar); typical of the Rotax operator manuals but NOT re-verified against docs/reference (verification row V-limits)
